scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir react-app/src/wasm -- --no-default-features && cargo build --release && npm install --prefix react-app && npm run build --prefix react-app
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix react-app && npm run build --prefix react-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "cargo run --bin local" "npm run dev --prefix react-app"
scripts.lint: cargo clippy -- -D warnings && npm run lint --prefix react-app
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt && npm run format --prefix react-app
